subject: integration
name: Cryptocurrency support standard (CRYPTO_ACCESS_0_1)
summary: Defines one call, supported, listing the standard codes of the cryptocurrencies the browser has an integration for, at most 64. The browser answers it itself and no integration can provide it, so the row names no provider; the browser's answering code is separate from this row. The definition itself says the list can tell a person apart from others, so a site learns it only through a grant the person gives. The row runs nothing and connects to nothing. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
